caseName: International Union of Operating Engineers, Local No. 12 v. Deacon
caseNameFull: INTERNATIONAL UNION OF OPERATING ENGINEERS, LOCAL NO. 12 v. DEACON
attorneys: Charles K. Hackler for appellants., Appellee pro se.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The appeal is dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for a writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
